llm_response.reason: The website mimics Intimissimi, a legitimate and well-known lingerie brand, but uses an unrelated domain name and lacks any verifiable company information. There are promises of secure shopping and free delivery which are generic and not substantiated. The privacy information is vague, and there is no legitimate contact information or evidence of official affiliation with Intimissimi. These are classic traits of scam websites: impersonation, ambiguous privacy policy, no business details, and misleading assurances about security.
